title: Concept: MySQL connection URI in a response
description: A MySQL URI that names the internal host in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The URI carries the host, the port and the database name, which is the addressing an attacker needs once any query path is injectable.
applicability: Deployments that render a MySQL URI that names the internal host into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The URI carries the host, the port and the database name, which is the addressing an attacker needs once any query path is injectable.
